ratios.quote: The maximum permitted leverage ratio is 5.00 . The Company’s leverage ratio was 4.03 at December 27, 2025.
The Company’s interest coverage ratio was 5.05 at December 27, 2025.

parsed.notes: Leverage ratio is calculated as average total indebtedness divided by Adjusted EBITDA, as defined in the credit agreement. The minimum interest coverage requirement steps up from 3.00 in fiscal 2026 to 3.25 in fiscal 2027 and 3.50 thereafter; 3.00 applies at December 27, 2025. The 4.00 leverage threshold governs unlimited restricted payments, not a maintenance covenant, so it is excluded. The same disclosure appears in both the notes and MD&A.
